taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 7.44 m – 45 m (Layer 3, 284 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive, 37.5 m-thick sand/sandstone unit between ~7.4 m and 45 m depth as the primary aquifer zone; case off the overlying low-resistivity layer (97.1 ohm-m, 1.23–7.44 m) to prevent clay/fine-sediment influx, and confirm bedrock contact near 45 m before terminating the borehole.
